observations.finding: Sandbox WSL access denied; host-authorized read succeeded. Normal Linux user docker socket denied and sudo -n required password.
observations.resolution: WSL root used for Docker; no group/socket permission changes.

observations.finding: Windows project .venv targets missing C:/Program Files/Python311/python.exe.
observations.resolution: Isolated WSL snapshot dependencies and built image Linux/Python3.12 for regression suites; project venv/lock not changed.

observations.finding: First /tmp snapshot dependency workspace was not found on the next call; cause not determined.
observations.resolution: Use recorded /var/tmp workspace; original setup log retained.

observations.finding: WSL root Git safe-directory guard rejected the user-owned checkout.
observations.resolution: Exact safe.directory passed per Git invocation only; no global config change.

observations.finding: Bootstrap script indentation and Git cwd errors occurred during preparation; initial Ruff E402 ordering findings were also observed.
observations.resolution: Corrected before applicable final freeze; delayed guarded imports explicitly annotated. No product changes.

observations.finding: attempt_01: internal bridge did not publish the host port. Service logs showed startup complete; host HTTP startup probe failed. Controlled continuation interrupted with finally cleanup.
observations.resolution: Dedicated bridge plus localhost-only binding and test-only HTTP/DNS/socket guard; first protocol/results/logs retained.

observations.finding: attempt_02: old observation directory caused FileExistsError before service creation.
observations.resolution: Unique namespace per run; restart reuses only its own SQLite volume. Attempt retained.

observations.finding: Dev Compose used curl absent from the built image: actual docker exec exit 127; regression RED 1 failed.
observations.resolution: Only dev service healthcheck changed to Python urllib /health; regression GREEN 1 passed; real Docker health healthy. RED logs retained in compose_red/.

observations.finding: Docker test process default RLIMIT_NOFILE soft=1024, hard=1048576. Aggregate rag_baseline/full exhausted descriptors.
observations.resolution: Only affected transient test containers use nofile=65536:65536; daemon/product limits unchanged. Initial logs retained in linux_default_limits_red/.

observations.finding: After descriptor adjustment: rag_baseline 3 failed/907 passed/10 skipped; full 9 failed/967 passed/12 skipped due missing Git, two corpus fixtures, and legacy AppTest relative cwd.
observations.resolution: Auxiliary test-tools image adds Git only; fixtures/.git read-only bind; test-only autouse cwd fixture for legacy app tests. Logs retained in linux_incomplete_test_context_red/. Service image, corpus and UI source unchanged.

observations.finding: Mounted cached test bytecode produced Windows source filenames in Linux tracebacks.
observations.resolution: Final aggregate test containers use a separate PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX; existing host bytecode is neither normalized nor deleted.
